source_facts: The admitted ModelExecution path already binds exact executor input_sha256 and input_size to an executor invocation in canonical MiniUnifiedDB.
The J-Space TrainingTrace independently binds JSPACE_VECTOR_CONTROL_ABI/v1 packet identity and control condition.

A parallel donor primitive HCU_MODEL_INPUT_CONTROL_BINDING/v1 now proves that one exact canonical Vector-Control packet occurs exactly once in exact executor-consumed input bytes and revalidates that byte identity.

That byte-level primitive accepts executor_id and invocation_id as parameters and therefore, by itself, does not prove that those labels correspond to the already atomically admitted ModelExecution parent row.

Serious causal training provenance therefore needs a trust-split join from the byte-level control binding to the previously admitted model-execution invocation and observation in the same canonical MiniUnifiedDB.
observation.hypothesis: Atomically admitting the byte-level ModelInputControlBinding against the exact existing ModelExecution invocation/observation rows closes the caller-label substitution gap without adding a second state authority.
observation.counterhypothesis: The byte-level binding alone is sufficient because its executor/invocation labels and input digest are already self-consistent.
observation.discriminator: Require existing canonical MiniUnifiedDB ModelExecution rows, semantically revalidate the stored observation bytes, cross-bind generation/GRID/cell/role/input identity, and reject missing, stale or divergent parent/binding cases.

delta.effect: Adds one fail-closed atomic admission layer inside the existing canonical MiniUnifiedDB. It requires an already admitted ModelExecution invocation/observation, revalidates canonical and semantic observation identity, binds generation, executor, invocation, GRID plan, cell, role and exact executor input SHA/size to the Vector-Control byte binding, and permits only one immutable control binding per invocation.
tests_encoded: exact admitted ModelExecution parent plus exact consumed input admits and replay is idempotent
missing ModelExecution parent fails before control tables are created
parent input digest mismatch fails closed and rolls back
same ModelExecution invocation cannot acquire a divergent control binding
stale generation fails before control write
semantically invalid parent observation cannot be laundered by a valid canonical hash

artefact_readme.reason: README is a large current-facing whole-file surface under active parallel churn; the available GitHub write primitive replaces the full file and a blind rewrite could clobber newer parallel state. Exact append-only receipt and donor commits preserve this macrocycle without unsafe whole-file overwrite.
